title: Cleaned up trace source cards
points: Failure case: trace source cards were hard to scan on mobile, with pale titles, raw URLs running as body text, and duplicated source labels.
Display logic changed: surfaced sources and source-log rows now share one compact source card with a strong title, metadata row, truncated URL, snippet, and open-source action.
Shipped result: source pages remain clickable, but the Verify stage reads like a source browser instead of a raw URL dump.
